newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - RACINE USD, WIS..

text.p: TAX AND REVENUE ANTICIPATION PROMISSORY NOTES
Bids will be received c/o Robert W. Baird & Co.
Incorporated, Milwaukee, Wisconsin until 10 o'clock a.m. (Central Time) on:
The Notes will be dated August 26, 1997 and will mature on August 24, 1998. Interest shall be payable at maturity.
The Notes will not be prepayable prior to maturity.
The approving legal opinion of Quarles & Brady of Milwaukee, Wisconsin and the transcript of proceedings will be furnished to the successful bidder without cost.

Additional information including the Bid Request and the Near Final Official Statement may be obtained by addressing inquiries to: Robert W. Baird & Co. Incorporated, 777 East Wisconsin Avenue, Milwaukee, WI 53202, Attention: Megan T. Vichich, telephone (414) 765-3827 or the undersigned.
